The opening is a continuation, se factorise en. Display (121) has an underbrace beneath its source term and a cancelled Pi M* label under that brace. H explicitly describes that same struck label in an editorial note, so its matching letter reading is not counted as a separate textual disagreement; the draft nevertheless reproduces the underbrace and cancelled annotation in the diagram.

The live source of (122) visibly has S_S, while (121) visibly has S_C. The S-shaped subscript is preserved as ink. This difference may be an authorial slip, but no correction to C is made from surrounding notation.

The vertical equivalence in (122) belongs beneath the left member. Its two parts are a wavy vertical stroke and a separate straight vertical stroke; the draft represents a rotated simeq without a vertical arrow. H's placement under the right/second member is not supported.

The first complete paragraph says that the transitivité relation is un peu compliquée and that the groupoids S_A Pi M_G dépend fonctoriellement on MD-graphes for morphismes de générisation. The singular dépend is kept despite the preceding plural groupoïdes. The inserted reference is written as (10 unsure{5|6}); its last digit is not resolved by the mathematical context.

The last paragraph begins MD-graphes, with no separate Les before it. After the main reader flagged the apparent article, I traced the already viewed rotated margin: the relevant strokes belong to the slanted marginal wording. C's Les and H's added Les are both omitted, without supplying grammar.

The last paragraph asserts that the MD-graphes and morphismes de générisation form a category, gives its parenthesised symbol, and says all morphisms are epimorphisms. The page stops after Cette catégorie satisfait. These are source claims only; no proof checking or theorem checking was carried out, and check_events is empty.

The margin has five baselines and is separate from the body parenthesised category symbol. Its opening reads La catégorie G joue le rôle d'un ens. and its ending reads ou des cas. The intervening noun and overlapping ending of géométriques remain local doubts; the parent's possible candidate complexes is recorded without asserting it.

All nine crops were made once from the original 1690 x 2359 image and inspected with view_image. Each was autocontrasted, enlarged with LANCZOS to 2700 pixels wide and mildly sharpened. Only the margin crop was rotated: -35 degrees in Pillow, i.e. clockwise 35 degrees. All stored boxes are coordinates in the original image. No new crops were made after the main reader's review.
